uncertain_sources.resolution: A severely garbled transition was limited to the secure expectation-value rule and cyclicity of the trace.
The indistinct eigenvalue exchange was resolved by the visible trace-one and determinant-zero calculation.
The corrupted entropy discussion was restricted to the secure contrast between zero entropy of the pure whole and nonzero entropy of its parts.
The mistranscribed classical principle was identified as microscopic reversibility and Liouville preservation of phase-space volume.
The garbled scalar analogy was retained only as the unit-modulus phase corresponding to scalar unitarity.
The indistinct exchange was resolved conservatively as the distinction between unitary inner-product preservation and preservation of product states.
The units discussion was regularized with separate information and thermodynamic entropies and an explicit Boltzmann conversion.
The shifting h and hbar notation was made consistent through E equals h nu equals hbar omega.
The garbled scalar differential equation was reconstructed directly from the displayed Schrodinger equation and energy eigenvalue relation.
